[LIMP.12.4] **`scope internal` belongs to the built-in module alone.** The
module may declare a schema `scope internal` ([LSCP.2.6]), and declares
`ComputationError` and `TypeError` so. No other source can: `internal` is absent
from the author grammar's `<scope-value>` ([LSCP.1.5], [LSCP.2.6.2]).

The module's declarations are the compiler's own, as [LLEX.9.5] treats a
schema the compiler declares.
